newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London mixed, exporters firm.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London mixed, exporters firm.

text.p: Japanese shares trading in London were mixed on Wednesday, with many exporters making gains on the back of the dollar's ascent to 46-month highs against the yen, dealers said.

The Tokyo stock market was closed for a holiday but dealers said a reasonable amount of trade had been seen in London. "It was fairly busy early on, purely on the back of a good dollar overnight," one dealer said. "Exporters were well bid."
By 1410 GMT, the Nikkei 50 average was down 0.17 points at 1,346.73. Canon was up 65 yen at 2,425.
